capabilities: Open the whole vault as an interactive 2D or 3D graph
Persist node positions, pins, and working constellations between sessions
Filter, search, and hide nodes without changing notes or links
Preview and focus on a note and its neighborhood while exploring
Embed the internal graph engine in other plugins
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer; community browser listing was pending approval at time of writing, so manual installation steps are provided. Resetting the layout requires exactly one Global graph pane open.
problem: Obsidian's native graph view is a static map and does not keep node positions between sessions or offer a spatial workflow for exploring and organizing connections.
summary: Interactive 2D/3D graph view for the vault with persistent node positions, filters, and an embeddable graph engine for other plugins.
